name: Empires Edge
description:
About This Game

FROM CAVES TO THE STARS

Begin your journey as the chief of a wild tribe on a floating island, and lead your people through six eras of evolution. Empires Edge breaks visual boundaries: watch as straw huts give way to stone fortresses, then to factories and futuristic laboratories. It is a journey from wooden clubs to battle mechs, where each era completely transforms the look and feel of your city.

CONQUEST OF FLOATING ISLANDS 

Expand your domain step by step, destroying enemy outposts and seizing territories rich in unique resources. This is not just base building — it’s true expansion: control the logistics between islands to ensure your growing empire functions as a single, well-oiled machine.

PEOPLE ARE THE ENGINE OF THE EMPIRE

Balancing population growth, workforce, and military might is the key to victory. The further you advance through the eras, the deadlier the conflicts—and the greater the losses you risk.

CLASH OF EMPERORS

You are not alone in this arms race. Leaders with unique bonuses—from aggressive early pressure to technological supremacy—fight for dominance across the map. Study your rivals, adapt your strategy to the terrain, and prove that your civilization is worthy of survival at the edge of the universe.
short_desc: Empires Edge is a strategy game about building a civilization on floating islands, inspired by the classic Mega Lo Mania. Lead your people, achieve technological breakthroughs, and conquer new territories as you forge an empire at the edge of the Universe.
